description: Header file defining logging macros, classes, and functions for the Starboard logging module, including LogMessage classes, log level controls, and macros for logging and assertions.

classes.name: LogMessage
classes.description: Class for constructing and managing log messages, including stream access and automatic message handling.

classes.name: LogMessageVoidify
classes.description: Helper class to facilitate lazy logging with operator&.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Represents a stack dump object with a specified number of frames to skip.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing log message with file, line, and priority.

methods.name: ~LogMessage
methods.description: Destructor for LogMessage, likely finalizing the log output.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the output stream for the log message.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloaded operators for outputting Stack, wchar_t*, and std::wstring objects.

methods.name: SetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the minimum log level for logging.

methods.name: GetMinLogLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current minimum log level.

methods.name: StringToLogLevel
methods.description: Converts a string representation of log level to SbLogPriority.

methods.name: Break
methods.description: Triggers a breakpoint or debugger break.
